# Introduction

Purpose of this notebook is preliminary analysis and scratch work for INSPIRE cost-effectiveness project

## Load libraries

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
library(magrittr)
library(rsample)
```


## Constants

```{r}
ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR = 2022
ZMB_CENSUS_POP = 10868136 # ages 15-64
```

# Read data

## Preliminary datasets

```{r}
experiment.path = "/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/INSPIRE/PHASE_2/Baseline-campaign_zmb_inspire-inspire_test_baseline___2025_08_07_17_43_20_997698/"

inspire.test.baseline <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
  experiment_path = experiment.path,
  scenario_name =  "baseline",
  summarize_columns = c("Population","Infected", "On_ART",
                      "Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                      "Newly.Infected","Diagnosed",
                      "ZAIMARA_INSPIRE","PrEP_INSPIRE","OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer"
                      ),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Age", "Gender", "HasIntervention.PrEP_INSPIRE", "HasIntervention.ZAIMARA" ),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
)

experiment.path = "/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/INSPIRE/PHASE_2/Baseline-campaign_zmb_inspire-inspire_test_prep___2025_08_08_09_45_18_369763/"

inspire.test.prep <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
  experiment_path = experiment.path,
  scenario_name =  "prep",
  summarize_columns = c("Population","Infected", "On_ART",
                      "Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                      "Newly.Infected","Diagnosed",
                      "ZAIMARA_INSPIRE","PrEP_INSPIRE","OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer"
                      ),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Age", "Gender", "HasIntervention.PrEP_INSPIRE", "HasIntervention.ZAIMARA"),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
)


experiment.path = "/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/INSPIRE/PHASE_2/Baseline-campaign_zmb_inspire-inspire_test_art___2025_08_07_17_43_41_529081/"

inspire.test.art <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
  experiment_path = experiment.path,
  scenario_name =  "art",
  summarize_columns = c("Population","Infected", "On_ART",
                      "Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                      "Newly.Infected","Diagnosed",
                      "ZAIMARA_INSPIRE","PrEP_INSPIRE","OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer"
                      ),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Age", "Gender", "HasIntervention.PrEP_INSPIRE", "HasIntervention.ZAIMARA" ),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
)


experiment.path = "/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/INSPIRE/PHASE_2/Baseline-campaign_zmb_inspire-inspire_test_zaimara___2025_08_07_17_43_40_261346/"

inspire.test.zaimara <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
  experiment_path = experiment.path,
  scenario_name =  "zaimara",
  summarize_columns = c("Population","Infected", "On_ART",
                      "Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                      "Newly.Infected","Diagnosed",
                      "ZAIMARA_INSPIRE","PrEP_INSPIRE","OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer"
                      ),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Age", "Gender", "HasIntervention.PrEP_INSPIRE", "HasIntervention.ZAIMARA" ),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
)

# inspire.test.baseline <- inspire.test.baseline %>% rename(HasIntervention.PrEP_INSPIRE = HasIntervention.PrEP_Inspire)
# inspire.test.art <- inspire.test.art %>% rename(HasIntervention.PrEP_INSPIRE = HasIntervention.PrEP_Inspire)
# inspire.test.zaimara <- inspire.test.zaimara %>% rename(HasIntervention.PrEP_INSPIRE = HasIntervention.PrEP_Inspire)

inspire.test.results <- rbind(
  inspire.test.baseline,
  inspire.test.prep,
  inspire.test.art,
  inspire.test.zaimara
  )

sim.results.pop.scaling <- inspire.test.results %>%
  filter(Year == ZMB_CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
  filter(Age >= 15, Age < 65) %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name) %>%
  summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
  mutate(pop_scaling_factor = ZMB_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)

inspire.test.results <- inspire.test.results %>%
  inner_join(
    sim.results.pop.scaling,
    by = c("sim.ix", "scenario_name")
  )
```

# Event counter

```{r}
inspire.test.results %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, sim.id) %>% 
  summarize(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = sum(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor),
            PrEP_INSPIRE = sum(PrEP_INSPIRE * pop_scaling_factor),
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor),
            .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = mean(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE),
            PrEP_INSPIRE = mean(PrEP_INSPIRE),
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = mean(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE, PrEP_INSPIRE, OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer),
           values_to = "Value", 
           names_to = "Metric") %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = scenario_name) )+ 
  facet_grid(rows = vars(Metric), scales = 'free_y')
```

```{r}
inspire.test.results %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, sim.id) %>%

            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = sum(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer * pop_scaling_factor),
            .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE = mean(ZAIMARA_INSPIRE),
            PrEP_INSPIRE = mean(PrEP_INSPIRE),
            OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer = mean(OnART1_INSPIRE_defaulter_tracer),
            .groups = 'drop_last') %>%
  filter(scenario_name == "art") %>%

```

```{r}
inspire.test.results %>% 
  filter(HasIntervention.PrEP_INSPIRE == 1) %>% 
  group_by(Year, scenario_name, sim.id) %>% 
  summarize(Population = sum(Population * pop_scaling_factor),
            Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor)) %>%
  group_by(Year, scenario_name) %>% 
  summarize(Population = mean(Population),
            Infected = mean(Infected)) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Population, color = scenario_name))
```

inspire.test.results %>%

# Plots

Now that I've established that the interventions are going out, do they have any effect whatsoever?

```{r}
inspire.test.results %>% 
  filter(Year > 2015) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, sim.ix) %>% 
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop_scaling_factor),
            Infected = sum(Infected * pop_scaling_factor), 
            Newly.Infected = sum(Newly.Infected * pop_scaling_factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop_scaling_factor)) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Infected = mean(Infected), 
            Newly.Infected = mean(Newly.Infected), 
            On_ART = mean(On_ART)
            ) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = c(Died_from_HIV, Infected, Newly.Infected, On_ART),
               values_to = "Value", 
               names_to = "Metric") %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = scenario_name ) ) + 
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(Metric), scales = "free_y")
```
